tiers.name: The Mogul
tiers.narrative: You read the room, took the right risks at the right moments, and came out ahead of almost everyone. Whether it was skill or nerve, the market remembers winners like you.
tiers.thresholdNote: TBD — tune exact final net worth / rank cutoff after Phase 1 engine is live and real simulated distributions are available.

tiers.name: The Survivor
tiers.narrative: You didn't chase every rumor, and you didn't panic when the market moved. You end roughly where you started — which, in this room, makes you one of the smart ones.

tiers.name: The Cautionary Tale
tiers.narrative: It wasn't your year. Maybe you trusted the wrong midnight post, maybe the Iron Fund saw you coming. Either way, the market has a lesson for you — and a great story for everyone else.

primaryDriver.definition: The single decision (across all 15 rounds) with the largest absolute dollar swing to the player's net worth, whether that swing was positive or negative. Ties broken by whichever happened more recently, so the punchline references something the player is likely to remember.
primaryDriver.computationNote: Server should track a running 'biggest swing so far' per player as each round's decisions resolve — compare each decision's outcomeAmount (positive or negative) against the current max absolute value, replace if larger.

templates.mogul: Primary driver: Timed the {eventLabel} to perfection.
templates.survivor: Primary driver: Kept {cashPct}% in cash while the room caught fire.
templates.cautionary_tale: Primary driver: Bought {personaName}'s Round {round} {eventType} with {pct}% of net worth.

templateVariables.eventLabel: Human-readable label of the event/sector tied to the biggest positive swing (e.g. 'Iron Fund pivot').
templateVariables.cashPct: Percentage of final net worth that stayed in liquid cash, for Survivor-tier players who invested conservatively.
templateVariables.personaName: Name of the persona tied to the biggest negative swing, if applicable.
templateVariables.round: Round number of the biggest negative swing decision.
templateVariables.eventType: Short label for what kind of event it was (e.g. 'tweet', 'leak', 'announcement').
